name: corsoul-codex
description: Connect Codex to one shared Corsoul long-term-memory service without manual MCP configuration.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to one shared loopback Corsoul service, provides an opt-in PM2-supervised persistent owner setup, and adds safe recall-and-capture workflows including an optional preview-first AGENTS.md strict mode. Local PGLite needs no Docker, Postgres, account, or API key.
defaultPrompt: Connect Corsoul and verify that Codex can recall memory.
Recall the durable decisions already made for this project.
Show the optional AGENTS.md memory setup. Preview it before editing.
